description: fmt data formats a document under the layout rules of format/shop.kdl: its schema-wide layout sets the line limits (64 columns of content); order is declared by default, so a node's properties follow its fields (size, kind, price) and the children its fields bind follow the same order (motto before owner, note before tag before run), but never across an empty line (apple's note stays below its group) and never across a child only a children rule admits (the banner stays put, with nothing moved over it) or one that is a record of its own (item, pack, bundle); pack declares a sequence and bundle opts out with order=authored, so their children keep their order; an enum value and a kebab-case value are written bare; a prose value is folded and refilled (the motto fits one line, the note fills three); a verbatim command stays on its line however long
